rung2.contentAnchor: 🔥 The real test: Copy your program onto the micro:bit: press Download in MakeCode, then drag the downloaded file onto the MICROBIT drive. Copying it across like this is called FLASHING the program onto the device — that is the word your teacher will use. The film button below replays exactly how, if you need it. Then press the real button B. Did the happy face appear? (If your device won't connect, the on-screen simulator counts while your teacher sorts it.)

bank.name: bank
bank.textSnippet: New tab → drive.google.com → open School → DT Work. Don't see those folders? Click + New → Folder, make 'School', open it, make 'DT Work' inside — thirty seconds, then carry on.
bank.contentAnchor: New tab → drive.google.com → open School → DT Work. Don't see those folders? Click + New → Folder, make 'School', open it, make 'DT Work' inside — thirty seconds, then carry on.
bank.cardText: 💾 · Download your build · In MakeCode press the purple Download button. A file ending in .hex lands in the computer's Downloads folder — that file IS your program. · 🗄️ · Open your Vault · New tab → drive.google.com → open School → DT Work. Don't see those folders? Click + New → Folder, make 'School', open it, make 'DT Work' inside — thirty seconds, then carry on. · 🎯 · Drag it in · Drag the .hex file from Downloads into DT Work. Done — the website can now verify it's really there.
